onAddComment.description: The function called when a comment is added to the document with the {@link https://api.onlyoffice.com/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/document-api/Methods/AddComment AddComment} method.

onBlurAnnotation.description: The function called when an annotation loses focus.

onBlurContentControl.description: The function called to show which content control has been blurred.

onChangeCommentData.description: The function called when the specified comment is changed with the {@link https://api.onlyoffice.com/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/document-api/Methods/ChangeComment ChangeComment} method.

onChangeContentControl.description: The function called to show which content control has been changed.

onChangeCurrentPage.description: The function called when the current page has changed.

onClickAnnotation.description: The function called when the user clicks an annotation.

onContentControlAdd.description: Fired when a content control is added to the document.

onContentControlRemove.description: Fired when a content control is removed from the document.

onFocusAnnotation.description: The function called when an annotation receives focus.

onFocusContentControl.description: The function called to show which content control has been focused.

onHideContentControlTrack.description: The function called when the content control loses focus in the document.

onInsertOleObjects.description: The function called when one or more OLE objects are inserted into the document.

onParagraphAdd.description: Fired when a paragraph is added to the document.

onParagraphRemove.description: Fired when a paragraph is removed from the document.

onParagraphText.description: The function called when the paragraph text is updated in the document.

params.name: data
params.type: { paragraphId: string; recalcId: string; text: string; annotations: TextAnnotationRange[] }

onRemoveComment.description: The function called when the specified comment is removed with the {@link https://api.onlyoffice.com/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/document-api/Methods/RemoveComments RemoveComments} method.

onShowContentControlTrack.description: The function called when the content control receives focus and its track appears.

onSubmitForm.description: The function called when the user clicks the "Complete & Submit" button.
